note: Predetermined Amharic questions for the test and the presentation. question = as typed in Latin letters. ethiopic = the same question in Ethiopic script (sent to the translation service). reply = the answer shown back in Latin letters. All three are required. The reply is shown only when the English question gets an answer.

entries.question: And mehaber chaptar be and amet wust sint yebord sibseba madreg alebet?
entries.ethiopic: አንድ የማህበር ቻፕተር በአንድ ዓመት ውስጥ ስንት የቦርድ ስብሰባ ማድረግ አለበት?
entries.reply: be-chaptaru memehiriya denb meselet, yechaptaru bord be-ametu wust be-zerzer mesebseb alebet, be-anestegwa arat yebord sibsebawoch be-amet. (Chapter Leader Guidebook - President (August 2026), page 7)
